identity_gate: Use an approved non-root deployment profile; current default profile resolves to root. No identity changes were performed.
assumptions: Reuse existing Stockholm VPC, subnets, Web/App EC2, internal ALB, and private encrypted Multi-AZ primary.
Source database currently has 20 GB gp2 storage; proposed replica uses matching capacity/storage type and a separate Single-AZ db.t4g.micro instance.
One LCU and two ALB public IPv4 addresses are planning allowances, not usage limits.
Totals use unrounded rates; displayed component rounding can differ by one cent.
Four-hour values are normalized equivalents; service minimum billing and proration differ.
excluded_costs: All pre-existing EC2, internal ALB, NAT, storage, public IPv4 and databases, including ha-mysql-db and Assignment 4; these may already be charging.
Data transfer, NAT processing, additional ALB LCUs/IPs, RDS CPU surplus credits, backups/snapshots, logging, API calls and taxes.
Additional web/app instances, new networking, private-management endpoints, migration work, cleanup delays or failed deletion.
approval_and_stop_plan: Obtain explicit approval of incremental spending, exact new-resource scope and retention/cleanup intent before apply. The Assignment 5 retest proposal does not authorize this capstone spend.
Establish approved non-root access and a safe way to inspect existing runtime/configuration before launching chargeable additions.
Use a dedicated new-additions-only Terraform state; existing shared infrastructure is referenced read-only, not imported for blanket destruction.

Abort testing if no stable UI/database baseline is established within 60 minutes of starting changes. Begin removal of only newly created resources by 120 minutes; reserve a four-hour target for cleanup and verification.
Continue cleanup if it exceeds the target. Do not delete state, source databases or shared VPC resources to meet a deadline.
No timer, budget alarm or hard spending cap has been installed. Billing alerts are delayed.
